purpose: Construct an independent, geographically stratified oceanic-island pollination-network validation sample before inspecting ABM fit to any selected network.

source_pool.primary: Web of Life weighted pollination networks

current_metadata_audit.warning: rows are not independent sampling units; repeated temporal/subnetwork records are common

independence_unit: unique location x reference x sampling-program unit, not raw Web of Life network row
deduplication_rules: Collapse repeated rows sharing the same normalized location and reference into one candidate sampling program unless the source explicitly defines independent island sites.
Seasonal or temporal replicates from one locality are not independent global island systems; retain them only to estimate within-system uncertainty.
Multiple habitats on the same island may remain separate observations only after island-level clustering is declared; they do not increase the count of independent islands.
island_admission_rules: The study location must be on a named island or archipelago with verifiable coordinates.
Oceanic-island origin must be verified from an external geological/island source before admission; continental islands are retained as controls, not pooled with oceanic islands.
The pollination network must be quantitative/weighted and source-native interaction counts must be retrievable.
Sampling location and reference must be recoverable from metadata.

A sampling-effort proxy must be available from the source, network metadata, or a clearly declared alternative; otherwise the network is descriptive-only and excluded from quantitative gradient fitting.
forbidden_selection_criteria: whether a network supports the proposed hypothesis
geographic_predictors_required_for_gradi: distance to mainland or explicitly defined source landmass

validation_design.primary: leave-one-island-system-out prediction across the fixed sample
validation_design.parameter_rule: No held-out island outcome or architecture label may be used to choose saturation, opportunity mapping, or other ABM parameters.
validation_design.reporting: Report absolute and rank/shape error; never select a preferred saturation value post hoc.

minimum_release_condition: At least four geographic strata with at least two independent oceanic-island systems each, or explicitly downgrade the analysis to partial global coverage.
relationship_to_traveset2016: This is a new preregistered validation sample and must not be presented as a reconstruction of the Traveset et al. 2016 18-oceanic-island subset. Exact Traveset reconstruction remains a separate source-gated analysis.
